entries.name: Choose cards for upcoming problems

facts.summary: Evaluate additions by the damage, defense and scaling problems ahead instead of forcing a preset archetype. Consider both energy and draw constraints.
facts.inspected_section: Resources; How to think about your deck; Archetypes

entries.name: Review the full turn before playing

facts.summary: Before committing a turn, compare lethal now or next turn, inspect the draw pile, and consider block, relic effects and available potions.
